toggle-group:
import { useState } from "react";
import { Stack, Text, Card, ToggleGroup } from "@colibri-kit/native-core";

export default function Example() {
  const [align, setAlign] = useState("center"), [format, setFormat] = useState(["bold", "italic"]), [view, setView] = useState("list");
  return (
    <Card gap="m">
      <Stack gap="2xs">
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">Alignment (single)</Text>
        <ToggleGroup accessibilityLabel="Text alignment" value={align} onChange={setAlign} options={[{ value: "left", label: "Left" }, { value: "center", label: "Center" }, { value: "right", label: "Right" }, { value: "justify", label: "Justify", disabled: true }]} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack gap="2xs">
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">Formatting (multiple)</Text>
        <ToggleGroup type="multiple" accessibilityLabel="Text formatting" value={format} onChange={setFormat} options={[
          { value: "bold", icon: <Text weight="bold">B</Text>, accessibilityLabel: "Bold" },
          { value: "italic", icon: <Text style={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>I</Text>, accessibilityLabel: "Italic" },
          { value: "underline", icon: <Text style={{ textDecorationLine: "underline" }}>U</Text>, accessibilityLabel: "Underline" },
          { value: "strike", icon: <Text style={{ textDecorationLine: "line-through" }}>S</Text>, accessibilityLabel: "Strikethrough" }]} />
        <Text style={{ fontWeight: format.includes("bold") ? "700" : "400", fontStyle: format.includes("italic") ? "italic" : "normal", textAlign: align ?? "left",
          textDecorationLine: [format.includes("underline") && "underline", format.includes("strike") && "line-through"].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || "none" }}>The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</Text>
      </Stack>
      <Stack gap="2xs">
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">Small, full width, always one on</Text>
        <ToggleGroup size="s" block required accessibilityLabel="Layout" value={view} onChange={setView} options={[{ value: "list", label: "List" }, { value: "board", label: "Board" }, { value: "calendar", label: "Calendar" }]} />
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  );
}
drawer:
import { useState } from "react";
import { useToast, useTheme, Stack, Cluster, Divider, Text, Button, Badge, Checkbox, RadioGroup, ListItem, Drawer } from "@colibri-kit/native-core";

export default function Example() {
  const toast = useToast(), theme = useTheme(), [side, setSide] = useState(null), close = () => setSide(null);
  const [stock, setStock] = useState(true), [sale, setSale] = useState(false), [sort, setSort] = useState("new");
  return (
    <Stack>
      <Cluster>
        <Button title="Filters (right)" variant="outline" onPress={() => setSide("right")} testID="open-drawer-right" />
        <Button title="Menu (left)" variant="outline" onPress={() => setSide("left")} testID="open-drawer-left" />
        <Button title="Details (bottom)" variant="outline" onPress={() => setSide("bottom")} testID="open-drawer-bottom" />
        <Button title="Notice (top)" variant="outline" onPress={() => setSide("top")} testID="open-drawer-top" />
      </Cluster>
      <Drawer visible={side === "right"} side="right" title="Filters" onClose={close}
        footer={<><Button title="Reset" variant="ghost" onPress={() => { setStock(true); setSale(false); setSort("new"); }} /><Button title="Show 24 results" onPress={() => { close(); toast.show("Filters applied", { tone: "ok" }); }} /></>}>
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">Availability</Text>
        <Stack gap="3xs"><Checkbox label="In stock" checked={stock} onChange={setStock} /><Checkbox label="On sale" checked={sale} onChange={setSale} /></Stack>
        <Divider />
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">Sort by</Text>
        <RadioGroup value={sort} onChange={setSort} options={[{ value: "new", label: "Newest first" }, { value: "low", label: "Price: low to high" }, { value: "high", label: "Price: high to low" }]} />
      </Drawer>
      <Drawer visible={side === "left"} side="left" title="Colibri Studio" onClose={close}>
        <Stack gap="3xs" style={{ marginHorizontal: -theme.space.m }}>
          {["Dashboard", "Articles", "Media library", "Members", "Settings"].map((name) => <ListItem key={name} title={name} trailing="›" onPress={() => { close(); toast.show(`Opened ${name}`); }} />)}
        </Stack>
      </Drawer>
      <Drawer visible={side === "bottom"} side="bottom" title="Order #4821" onClose={close}>
        <Cluster justify="space-between"><Text tone="muted">Status</Text><Badge tone="ok">Shipped</Badge></Cluster>
        <Cluster justify="space-between"><Text tone="muted">Carrier</Text><Text>DHL Express</Text></Cluster>
        <Cluster justify="space-between"><Text tone="muted">Arrives</Text><Text>Thursday, 14 March</Text></Cluster>
        <Button title="Track parcel" block onPress={close} />
      </Drawer>
      <Drawer visible={side === "top"} side="top" title="Scheduled maintenance" onClose={close}>
        <Text tone="muted">Publishing is paused on Sunday from 02:00 to 03:00 UTC while we upgrade the database.</Text>
        <Button title="Got it" variant="soft" onPress={close} />
      </Drawer>
    </Stack>
  );
}
dropdown-menu:
import { useState } from "react";
import { useToast, Stack, Cluster, Text, Button, Card, Badge, AlertDialog, DropdownMenu } from "@colibri-kit/native-core";

export default function Example() {
  const toast = useToast(), [published, setPublished] = useState(true), [language, setLanguage] = useState("ka"), [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  const items = [
    { type: "label", label: "Article" },
    { label: "Edit", shortcut: "⌘E", onSelect: () => toast.show("Editing article") },
    { label: "Duplicate", onSelect: () => toast.show("Article duplicated", { tone: "ok" }) },
    { label: "Archive", disabled: true },
    { type: "separator" },
    { type: "checkbox", label: "Published", checked: published, onChange: setPublished },
    { type: "radio", label: "Language", value: language, onChange: setLanguage, options: [{ value: "ka", label: "Georgian" }, { value: "en", label: "English" }] },
    { label: "Share", items: [{ label: "Copy link", onSelect: () => toast.show("Link copied", { tone: "ok" }) }, { label: "Email", onSelect: () => toast.show("Opening mail") }] },
    { type: "separator" },
    { label: "Delete", destructive: true, onSelect: () => setAsking(true) },
  ];
  return (
    <Stack>
      <Card>
        <Cluster justify="space-between" wrap={false}>
          <Stack gap="3xs" style={{ flex: 1 }}><Text weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>Getting started with Colibri</Text>
            <Cluster><Badge tone={published ? "ok" : undefined}>{published ? "Published" : "Draft"}</Badge><Badge>{language === "ka" ? "Georgian" : "English"}</Badge></Cluster></Stack>
          <DropdownMenu label="Article actions" align="end" items={items} trigger={<Button title="⋯" variant="ghost" accessibilityLabel="Article actions" testID="open-menu-more" />} />
        </Cluster>
      </Card>
      <Cluster>
        <DropdownMenu label="Article actions" items={items} trigger={<Button title="Actions ⌄" variant="outline" testID="open-dropdown-menu" />} />
        <DropdownMenu label="Article actions" presentation="sheet" items={items} trigger={<Button title="As a sheet" variant="outline" testID="open-menu-sheet" />} />
      </Cluster>
      <AlertDialog visible={asking} variant="danger" title="Delete this article?" description="This cannot be undone." confirmLabel="Delete"
        onCancel={() => setAsking(false)} onConfirm={() => { setAsking(false); toast.show("Article deleted", { tone: "bad" }); }} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
motion-wired:
import { useState } from "react";
import { useToast, useTheme, Stack, Cluster, Text, Heading, Button, Card, Badge, Callout, Tabs, Dialog, Sheet, Enter, Presence, MotionPressable, Collapse, useReducedMotion } from "@colibri-kit/native-core";

function ReducedNote() {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return reduced ? <Callout tone="warn" title="Reduced motion is on">Your device asks for less motion, so everything here jumps straight to its end state.</Callout> : null;
}

export default function Example() {
  const theme = useTheme(), toast = useToast(), [open, setOpen] = useState(false), [banner, setBanner] = useState(true), [dialog, setDialog] = useState(false), [sheet, setSheet] = useState(false), [tab, setTab] = useState("day");
  const totals = { day: ["$1,240", "38 orders today"], week: ["$8,410", "251 orders this week"], month: ["$34,900", "1,022 orders this month"] }[tab];
  return (
    <Stack gap="m">
      <ReducedNote />
      <Card>
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">Built in</Text>
        <Cluster>
          <Button title="Dialog (fade)" variant="outline" onPress={() => setDialog(true)} />
          <Button title="Sheet (slide)" variant="outline" onPress={() => setSheet(true)} />
          <Button title="Toast (fade)" variant="outline" onPress={() => toast.show("Saved to your library", { tone: "ok" })} />
        </Cluster>
      </Card>
      <Card gap="xs">
        <MotionPressable effect="dim" onPress={() => setOpen(!open)} accessibilityState={{ expanded: open }} aria-expanded={open} testID="toggle-collapse"
          style={{ minHeight: theme.touch, flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: theme.space.s }}>
          <Text weight="semibold" style={{ flex: 1 }}>Delivery details</Text><Text tone="muted">{open ? "−" : "+"}</Text>
        </MotionPressable>
        <Collapse open={open}>
          <Stack gap="xs" style={{ paddingBottom: theme.space["2xs"] }}>
            <Text size="sm" tone="muted">Arrives Thursday 14 November between 9 am and 1 pm. The courier will text you an hour before.</Text>
            <Cluster><Badge tone="ok">Free delivery</Badge><Badge>Signature required</Badge></Cluster>
          </Stack>
        </Collapse>
      </Card>
      <Stack gap="xs">
        <Presence visible={banner} motion="slide-down" appear>
          <Callout tone="accent" title="Update ready">Version 2.4 was downloaded in the background.</Callout>
        </Presence>
        <Button title={banner ? "Dismiss the banner" : "Show the banner"} variant="ghost" size="s" onPress={() => setBanner(!banner)} />
      </Stack>
      <Card>
        <Tabs value={tab} onChange={setTab} options={[{ value: "day", label: "Day" }, { value: "week", label: "Week" }, { value: "month", label: "Month" }]} />
        <Enter key={tab} motion="slide-left" distance={16}><Heading level={2}>{totals[0]}</Heading><Text size="sm" tone="muted">{totals[1]}</Text></Enter>
      </Card>
      <Dialog visible={dialog} onClose={() => setDialog(false)} title="Animated dialog" actions={<Button title="Close" onPress={() => setDialog(false)} />}>It fades in over the backdrop and out again.</Dialog>
      <Sheet visible={sheet} onClose={() => setSheet(false)} title="Animated sheet"><Stack gap="xs"><Text tone="muted">It slides up from the bottom edge.</Text><Button title="Close" variant="outline" block onPress={() => setSheet(false)} /></Stack></Sheet>
    </Stack>
  );
}
svg-progress-ring:
import { useState } from "react";
import { View } from "react-native";
import { Stack, Cluster, Text, Button, Card, ProgressRing } from "@colibri-kit/native-full";

export default function Example() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(0.64);
  return (
    <Stack gap="m">
      <Card>
        <Cluster gap="l" justify="space-around" align="flex-end">
          <ProgressRing value={value} size="s" label="Small" />
          <ProgressRing value={value} label="Medium" testID="svg-ring" />
          <ProgressRing value={value} size="l" label="Large" />
        </Cluster>
        <Cluster>
          <Button title="−10%" variant="outline" size="s" onPress={() => setValue((now) => Math.max(0, +(now - 0.1).toFixed(2)))} />
          <Button title="+10%" variant="outline" size="s" onPress={() => setValue((now) => Math.min(1, +(now + 0.1).toFixed(2)))} />
        </Cluster>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <Cluster gap="l" justify="space-around" align="flex-end">
          <ProgressRing value={1} tone="ok" label="Done" />
          <ProgressRing value={0.82} tone="warn" label="Storage" />
          <ProgressRing value={0.97} tone="bad" label="Quota" />
          <ProgressRing indeterminate label="Syncing" />
        </Cluster>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <Cluster gap="m" wrap={false}>
          <ProgressRing value={5 / 8} size={72} thickness={8} accessibilityLabel="Steps done"><Text weight="bold">5/8</Text></ProgressRing>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}><Text weight="semibold">Set up your workspace</Text><Text size="sm" tone="muted">Three steps left. Any content can sit in the middle of the ring.</Text></View>
        </Cluster>
      </Card>
    </Stack>
  );
}
